All 18 rules were searched and the plan is submitted.

**Summary of the plan (APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement — multilateral consortium, we are Teleglobe USA Inc.):**

- **Located, needing substantive review:** LOL-CAP (¶21.3 p0242, ¶4.9 p0126), INDEMN (¶21.2 p0241; Paragraph 32 p0275/p0280), T4C & RENEWAL (Paragraph 18 exit/Initial-Period regime p0228–p0235), GOVLAW (¶27.1 p0262 — committee-determined arbitration as sole and exclusive remedy, no choice of law surfaced), ASSIGN (¶22.1 p0246; ¶30 p0269), AUDIT (Paragraph 9 p0160/p0167; ¶10.8 p0177), LD (Paragraph 23 default/capacity reclamation p0255–p0256; extended payment charges p0153–p0157), WARRANTY (¶4.9–4.10 p0126–p0127 disclaimers), MINCOMMIT (Investment Share/MIU p0055, p0187 plus Paragraphs 5 and 7), TRANSITION (Paragraph 18 realization of assets; p0280; p0180/p0185).
- **Located but likely in our favour / analogue only:** IP and LICENSE map to asset-ownership and IRU rights (p0107, p0119, p0187, p0054, p0206, p0208), not IP or customer data; INSURANCE appears only as a cost category (p0133, p0139).
- **Likely absent:** MFN, NOSOLICIT (no hits at all); NONCOMPETE and EXCLUSIVITY (only false positives — "competent tribunal", "sole and exclusive remedy"), with capacity provisions expressly unrestricted.

Cross-rule notes flagged for workers: avoid double-flagging the Paragraph 18/23 exit-cost economics under both T4C and LD, and treat the ¶27.1 exclusive-remedy language under GOVLAW rather than EXCLUSIVITY.
